_note: Toy Army bedroom surfaces. Generate in Studio (generate_material), fill in the ids. ToyFloorWood is used white; ToyRugCarpet and ToyBlanket are near-white on purpose because Room.lua tints them (rug rings blue/white/light blue, blanket teal) and Part.Color multiplies the texture. Until the ids exist World.texture keeps the flat palette colours and Room.lua draws plank seams from thin parts, so the room already reads right flat.
